name: advisor
description: One fresh, read-only consultation for material technical decisions.

author.name: David Schmidt / Zero Delta LLC (maintainer); Daniel McAteer (original author)

interface.shortDescription: Read-only advice for material technical decisions.
interface.longDescription: Advisor implicitly matches material architecture, interface, data-model, compatibility, cross-boundary, and competing-diagnosis decisions. The root declares consult or skip before implementation, then surrounds every consult with visible ADVISOR CALL and ADVISOR RESULT receipts. It selects one of two model-pinned read-only roles by decision risk, verifies the exact completed spawn event, and records accept, modify, reject, or blocked. Standard consultation and generic advisor requests use Advisor Terra. Advisor Sol is reserved for unresolved security or trust boundaries, irreversible migration or data-loss decisions, and credible unresolved High-severity disagreement. Security adjacency and project importance alone do not qualify for Specialist consultation; borderline role choices use Advisor Terra. Unavailable evidence is visibly blocked and fail-closed. Receipts summarize evidence but the native child thread remains the runtime record. Advice is non-authoritative, and the plugin never implements, routes work, or performs final review.
defaultPrompt: Use $advisor:consultation for a material technical decision.
Ask Advisor for a fresh, read-only second opinion.
